items.question: How many people were aboard the cargo ship Julie C when it struck the Jack Edwards off Guyana?
items.expected_answer: There were 17 people aboard the Julie C (the Jack Edwards had 10).
items.notes: Tests retrieval of a per-vessel figure from the casualty summary table, where both vessels' counts sit on one row.

items.question: How broad was the approach channel off Georgetown, Guyana, where the Jack Edwards and the Julie C came together, and how much water was charted in it?
items.expected_answer: The unprotected approach channel was 148 feet wide, with a charted depth of 16 feet in the channel (8 feet outside it).

evidence.quote: Waterway information Unprotected approach channel, width 148 ft; charted depth 16 ft in channel, 8 ft outside of channel

items.notes: Tests retrieval of waterway dimensions from the casualty summary table; the same figures also appear in the narrative section.
